entries.sense_en: a person's face, especially the expression on it

synonyms.nuance: Plain everyday word for the front of the head; says nothing about expression.
Only the look shown on the face, not the face itself.
Literary and formal; a face seen as a whole, often solemn.

entries.sense_en: quickly and in an energetic, businesslike way

synonyms.nuance: Only speed; briskly also suggests energy and purpose.
Stresses effort and vigor rather than speed or efficiency.
Fast but careless or rushed; briskly sounds competent.

entries.sense_en: threw himself into a task suddenly and completely

synonyms.nuance: Similar image of jumping in headfirst; often eager and deliberate.
Stresses total effort and commitment.
Suggests being deeply absorbed over time, not a sudden jump.

entries.sense_en: very attractive; drawing people in by its charm

synonyms.nuance: General and mild; nothing about drawing someone in.
Makes you want to do or have something you perhaps should not.
Stronger, often sexual or deliberately persuasive.

entries.sense_en: chose not to have or use something

synonyms.nuance: Everyday phrase; you lack it, by choice or not.
Stop having or doing something, often with a sense of loss.
Formal; give up a right or claim.

entries.tip_ko: forgo는 forego로도 씁니다. 본문의 forewent는 forego의 과거형으로, '포기했다'는 뜻입니다.

entries.sense_en: exactness; the dress fitted her body closely and accurately

synonyms.nuance: Closeness to the truth or a standard; used for facts and measurements.
More often loyalty to a person; can also mean staying true to an original.
Devotion to people or a cause; no idea of exactness.

entries.sense_en: good taste and care; not being showy or drawing attention
entries.sense_ko: 신중함, 분별 있고 눈에 띄지 않는 절제

synonyms.nuance: Care not to offend others in what you say or do.
Careful judgment about risks and the future.
Not showing off; here close in meaning for clothing.

entries.tip_ko: '재량'이라는 뜻도 있어 at your discretion(당신의 재량으로)처럼 씁니다.

entries.sense_en: mixed with a small amount of another feeling

synonyms.nuance: Slightly colored; mostly about actual color.
Lightly affected by a feeling or quality.
Influenced, sometimes unfairly, by a feeling or opinion.

entries.sense_en: a pleasant memory of something that happened before

synonyms.nuance: Any remembered thing; not necessarily fond or long past.
Memory that you deliberately call up; neutral in mood.
A longing feeling for the past, stronger and sadder.

entries.sense_en: a large, brightly colored tropical parrot

synonyms.nuance: The general group; a macaw is one large long-tailed kind.
A different parrot with a crest of feathers on its head.

entries.sense_en: soft pink like a ripe peach

synonyms.nuance: Pink and healthy-looking, used mostly for cheeks and skin.
Reddened by heat, emotion or effort, more temporary.
Fresh and healthy in general, not just in color.

entries.sense_en: unsure what to do; hesitating

synonyms.nuance: Slow to act because of doubt; the most common everyday word.
Describes a person who generally can't make up their mind.
Switching between choices instead of standing still.

entries.sense_en: abrupt and short in manner, without friendliness or politeness

synonyms.nuance: Very short in speech, almost rude; about words more than manner.
Sudden and unexpected, without polite lead-in.
Honest and direct, with little care for feelings.

entries.sense_en: lasting a long time and constantly returning; here playfully, the phone kept buzzing

synonyms.nuance: Never stopping; no idea of illness.
Continuing despite efforts to stop it.
Done as a regular habit, usually by a person.

entries.tip_ko: chronic은 주로 병에 쓰며, 반대말은 acute(급성)입니다.

entries.sense_en: to crowd into a place in large numbers

synonyms.nuance: Common everyday word; gather closely together.
Move in a dense, restless mass, like insects.
Go somewhere together in large numbers, usually willingly.

entries.sense_en: in a cheerful, good-humored, friendly way

synonyms.nuance: Happily; the plain, mild word.
Playful and lively, often with laughter or singing.
Warmly and kindly; quieter and less hearty than jovially.

entries.sense_en: starting and stopping; coming in short bursts

synonyms.nuance: Without a regular pattern; doesn't imply bursts.
Happening at scattered times and places; often for events.
Unable to settle; often used of sleep.

entries.sense_en: of the basic forces of nature such as storm and fire

synonyms.nuance: Broad: found in nature; not suggesting raw power.
Belonging to the earliest, most basic instincts.
Fundamental and simple, with no sense of wildness.

entries.sense_en: carried out business deals

synonyms.nuance: Carry out or manage an activity, business or meeting.
Everyday word for dealing with a matter.
Bargain to reach an agreement, not just carry out a deal.

entries.sense_en: the ability to move quickly and lightly

synonyms.nuance: Quick and light on the feet or fingers; a little more playful.
Only how fast, without lightness or skill.
Skill with the hands, not the whole body.

entries.sense_en: a comic stage character in a colorful costume who leaps and dances
entries.sense_ko: 할리퀸(알록달록한 옷을 입고 재빨리 뛰어다니는 희극 배역)

synonyms.nuance: A general funny performer; not known for speed and grace.
A court fool from the past who jokes for a king.
Performer of gymnastic feats; focuses on skill, not comedy.

entries.sense_en: a short, loose jacket for women

synonyms.nuance: General word for a short coat.
Sleeveless cloak worn over the shoulders.

entries.sense_en: calm and confident, in full control of oneself

synonyms.nuance: Calm even when stressed; slightly more formal.
Calm and graceful in manner, often on display.
Believes in oneself; doesn't imply staying calm under pressure.

entries.sense_en: to work out the meaning of; here, to explain what she wanted

synonyms.nuance: Explain the meaning of something unclear; the common word.
Change into another language; here used humorously.
Informal: understand something in a certain way.

entries.sense_en: to cancel an order that was already given

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for calling off something planned.
Formal; officially take back a law, right or decision.
Reject a decision using higher authority.

entries.sense_en: forgetful because your mind is on something else
entries.sense_ko: 정신이 딴 데 팔린, 건망증이 있는

synonyms.nuance: Often fails to remember things; no idea of distraction.
Attention pulled away at a given moment.
Informal: disorganized and always losing track of things.

entries.sense_en: put in danger of loss

synonyms.nuance: Everyday word for putting people or things at risk.
Risk losing something valuable such as a plan or job.
Suggests a possible harm coming; not yet happened.

entries.sense_en: a short quiet time in the middle of activity

synonyms.nuance: A short stop, planned or not.
Quietness; often before or after a storm.
A rest that is usually planned.

entries.sense_en: not moving at all; frozen still

synonyms.nuance: Not moving at the moment; the plain descriptive word.
Fixed to the spot, as if it had roots.
Refusing to change one's mind, not about body movement.

entries.sense_en: so clearly that she seemed almost touchable

synonyms.nuance: In a way involving the body or the real world.
So obvious it can almost be felt; used of feelings.
In a real, definite way, not vague.

entries.sense_en: became smaller and smaller

synonyms.nuance: Get smaller in size; can be sudden.
Formal; get less in size, amount or importance.
Lose brightness or strength slowly.

entries.sense_en: an old exclamation showing surprise or decision

synonyms.nuance: Same old-fashioned exclamation with a different name.
Surprise or shock, not decision.
synonyms.example: Good heavens, look at the time!

synonyms.nuance: Informal American way to express surprise.

entries.sense_en: held tightly, as if afraid of dropping it

synonyms.nuance: Hold firmly; steady and strong.
Take hold of something, often with the fingers.
Hold closely with fingers or arms, sometimes tenderly.

entries.sense_en: hitting very hard; here, driving the price down hard
entries.sense_ko: 혹독하게 두들겨 패다(여기서는 주가를 심하게 떨어뜨리다)

synonyms.nuance: Hit someone repeatedly; plain and direct.
Attack or defeat again and again, also for markets.
Suddenly take away the strength or breath of.
synonyms.example: knock the wind out of him

entries.sense_en: impatiently and unable to keep still

synonyms.nuance: Annoyed by waiting or delay.
Unable to rest or stay still; a milder, more physical word.
Anxiously, from worry rather than being in a hurry.

entries.sense_en: became less busy or less intense

synonyms.nuance: Become less severe or pressing, usually gently.
Become slower; everyday phrase.
Sink to a lower level after being strong, as of noise or storm.

entries.sense_en: quickly took a short amount of time when it was available

synonyms.nuance: Informal: take quickly, often in a hurry or by force.
Take hold suddenly and firmly; stronger, more formal.
Get something quietly or secretly; here 'steal a moment'.

entries.sense_en: gently and lovingly

synonyms.nuance: With soft care; doesn't need love behind it.
With clear affection.
Showing fondness; a bit more formal than lovingly.
